meta.coords: frame x/y/w/h = atlas px; box = logical art rect inside sprite (px); nine = [l,t,r,b] px from sprite edges (0 = 唔切嗰邊); slice 9 | 3h (固定高) | 3v (固定闊); pivot = sprite px; art = logical size in art px
meta.draw: drawImage(atlas, x,y,w,h, dx - box[0]/s*a, dy - box[1]/s*a, w/s*a, h/s*a)  where s = atlas scale, a = art->device px
meta.alpha: 8-bit alpha (glow/glass/antialias) — 同寵物 sprite 嘅 0/255 唔同；pixel 字體係 0/255
